properties.Name: Point of Confluence
properties.Description: Where the Allegheny and Monongahela rivers meet to form the Ohio. The site's strategic value drove decades of contest between French, British, and Indigenous nations.

properties.Name: Fort Pitt
properties.Description: British fortification built after the French abandoned Fort Duquesne. A sample point showing how a single site anchors a much larger story.

properties.Description: A LINE feature. In your project this might be a canal, a rail line, a road, or a migration path. Lines show connection and movement.
